title: Terrain
description: A kind of ground on a Battlefield cell.

replace.description: Replace an existing definition with this id.

colour.description: Placeholder colour the client draws it in.

cover.description: Added to the To-hit roll of attacks against a ground unit standing here; negative is cover.

movement.description: Per Unit Class id, the cost of entering a cell of this Terrain. A Unit Class missing here can't enter it.
